# About Us

**Team Yadokari** is an international civic technology collaboration bringing together contributors from Canada and Japan.
The team develops human-centered technology solutions aimed at making government services and public support programs more accessible.

**Mimi**, the flagship project of Team Yadokari, explores how artificial intelligence, conversational interfaces, and computational policy systems can reduce barriers between citizens and public institutions.
